title: Irrigation command
description: Published by the decision service on smart-gardening/{device_id}/commands. The target device is the one in the topic.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped on any breaking change.

command_id.description: Unique ID of the command, used for deduplication and echoed in events.

duration_s.description: How long to open the valve, in seconds.

issued_at.description: When the command was created, UTC.

expires_at.description: After this instant the device must reject the command (reason expired). Must be later than issued_at.
